basic_details.job_title: Kerala University Guest Lecturer Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | guest lecturer (german): MA German Language & Literature with UGC NET in German/PhD in German

selection_process: The selection process consists of a direct walk-in interview.
how_to_apply: Check the detailed job notification on the official website at https://www.keralauniversity.ac.in/jobs.
Verify eligibility regarding qualifications and NET/PhD requirements.
Prepare all required educational and professional certificates in original.
Attend the walk-in interview directly at the German Department functioning at the Palayam campus of the University.
Report for the interview on 22 October 2026 at 11:00 AM.
important_instructions: Candidates must attend the interview in person at the specified venue and time. Only candidates with the prescribed qualifications (MA in German Language & Literature with UGC NET or PhD) are eligible to participate. Detailed notifications and job updates can be checked through the official Kerala University website. For queries, candidates can contact via email at [email protected] or through the provided University phone numbers.

faq.question: Q1. What is Kerala University Guest Lecturer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment process conducted by Kerala University to select Guest Lecturers for the German Department on a contract basis through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Kerala University Guest Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview for Kerala University Guest Lecturer?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 22 October 2026 at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the Kerala University Guest Lecturer walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held directly at the Department of German Studies operating at the Palayam campus of the University.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for Kerala University Guest Lecturer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MA in German Language & Literature with UGC NET in German or a PhD in German.
